items.name: HP Electric Blue
items.role: the system's lone signal — primary CTA fill, link color, chevron-decoration fill, active sub-nav indicator. Reserved.

items.name: Bright Blue
items.role: a slightly lighter variant used inside dark slabs (testimonial-card buttons, dark-band CTA links) where the deeper blue would muddy.

items.name: Deep Navy
items.role: pressed state for the primary CTA and the visited-link color.

items.name: Soft Blue
items.role: pale-blue surface used inside customer-story cards and selection chips.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: the universal page background. White, full opacity.

items.name: Paper
items.role: card surfaces — same white as canvas, with hairline borders or shadows providing the lift.

items.name: Cloud
items.role: the lightest gray section band, used for alternating-row backgrounds and product-feature card groups.

items.name: Fog
items.role: a slightly darker gray surface band, used for FAQ outer panels and the "Trending laptops" header strip.

items.name: Steel
items.role: hairline border used on outlined elements with stronger emphasis (focus states, active filter).

items.name: Bloom Coral / Bloom Rose
items.role: the "Get 25% off" sale-tag chip + soft pink lifestyle accent on the sale hero.

items.name: Storm Mist / Sea / Deep
items.role: the teal-storm tones reserved for the printer-plan illustration backdrop and supporting infographic accents.

items.name: Ink
items.role: the universal text color on white surfaces — headlines, body, button labels, navigation.

items.name: Ink Deep
items.role: pure black used for the wordmark and 1px hairline strokes around badge outlines.

items.name: Ink Soft
items.role: an alternate near-black used inside dark-navy slabs as a subtle textural shift.

items.name: On Ink
items.role: pure white used for headline and body text on every dark-navy slab.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: muted body color on white surfaces — secondary descriptions, fine-print disclaimers.

items.name: Graphite
items.role: smaller-print color, used for legal lines and timestamp metadata.

items.name: Bloom Deep
items.role: + Bloom Wine (#5a1313): error and discount-emphasis colors. The deep brick reads as "sale" or "destructive" depending on placement.

items.name: Storm Deep
items.role: used as a neutral status accent (e.g., printer-plan tier "Versatile" tier color).
